project.title: Positive Effects of Zeolite Powder on Aerobic Granulation: Nitrogen and Phosphorus Removal and Insights into the Interaction Mechanism
project.description: Aerobic granular sludge is considered to be one of the most promising biological wastewater treatment technologies of the 21st century. However, the long granulation time and poor treatment effect on N and P have severely limited its popularization and large-scale application. In this study, we systematically examined the strengthening effects of zeolite powder on granulation and N and P removal, and their interaction mechanism. The addition of zeolite powder shortened the sludge granulation time to 18 days and improved the average N and P removal rates by 4.48% and 2.22%, respectively. This is the result of the combined action of physical, chemical, and biological factors. The multi-pore and nutrient-rich environment of zeolite powder are beneficial to the maintenance of microbial activity and granule stability. Moreover, its adsorption to N and P enriches their respective removal strains, thereby improving their removal effect.
